from collections import deque

def hot_potato(names, k):
    q = deque(names)
    while len(q) > 1:
        # Pass the potato k-1 times; the k-th holder is eliminated
        q.rotate(-(k - 1))
        q.popleft()
    return q[0]

players = ['Alice', 'Bob', 'Charlie', 'David', 'Eve']
winner = hot_potato(players, 3)
print(f'Winner: {winner}')
